records.summary: Seahawks rookie RB Jadarian Price returns Monday night alongside veteran Zach Charbonnet for first game together.
records.source_excerpt: The Seahawks will have veteran running back Zach Charbonnet and rookie running back Jadarian Price in the same game for the first time on Monday.

records.summary: Price remains on injured reserve with chest injury, no designation for Week 8 game vs Bears.
records.source_excerpt: Price (chest) doesn't have a designation for Monday's game against the Bears, but he remains on injured reserve, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
